meta.title: AgentBridge — Connector Registry & Lifecycle Management
meta.subtitle: Central In-Process Authority & Future Generic Analyzer Flow
meta.description: Lifecycle orchestration, availability guard, and inspection pipeline decoupling connector definitions, registry management, future generic analysis, and verified operational state.

states.label: Connector Definition
states.description: Connector instance declared with unique connector_id, provider, type (MCP/REST/CLI), and capabilities.

states.label: Connector Registry
states.description: Instance registered into ConnectorRegistry. Checks duplicate ID uniqueness and records registration event into ActivityStore.

states.label: Availability Guard
states.description: Verifies whether the connector instance is administratively enabled or disabled.

states.label: Disabled State
states.description: Connector is administratively disabled. Connection attempts and executions are rejected with ConnectorDisabledError.

states.label: Instance Lifecycle FSM
states.description: Per-instance state machine transitions through REGISTERED, CONNECTING, READY, DEGRADED, DISCONNECTED, or ERROR.

states.label: Generic Analyzer Pipeline (Phase 7.4)
states.description: Consumes standardized ConnectorAnalysisDescriptor without provider-specific branching. Evaluates configuration, transport, and credentials.

states.label: Environment / Client Checks
states.description: Evaluates applicability to local workstation tools (Cursor, VS Code, local CLI, SUTRA runtime).

states.label: Diagnostic Verification
states.description: Probes connector health diagnostics. Confirms operational status without blocking unrelated instances.

states.label: Verified Connector
states.description: Connector instance confirmed ready, verified, and available for agent tool execution.

states.label: Degraded / Error State
states.description: Instance marked ERROR or DEGRADED with diagnostic reasons logged in ActivityStore.
